before: An insertion at the leading edge of a content-locked, data-bound, checkbox or picture control resolved inside the control, so it was refused or wrote into a checkbox glyph.
after: The insertion lands in a run beside the control at either edge. Inserts strictly inside a locked or bound control are still refused.
reason: Peers replicate the resulting tree primitives, a run inserted beside a control, which released participants already apply with the same meaning. No shared format field changes.
